news.title: Crypto investment firm Keyrock is acquiring bankrupt lender Blockfills

news.title: Strategy sold bitcoin in late May, and told the market in June. Here's how Polymarket bettors are fighting over when it counts.

news.title: Mt. Gox moves 10,422 bitcoin worth $739 million to a new wallet as deadline nears
news.summary: The 04:47 UTC Bitcoin block 952,072 transaction moved coins from Mt. Gox cold storage into a freshly generated address, with a smaller 116-bitcoin slice routed to the defunct exchange's hot wallet.

news.title: Bitcoin's biggest ETF selloff yet hits $3.4 billion as AI stocks keep climbing
